description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing orders in a food delivery backend. It includes endpoints for creating orders, listing user-specific orders, retrieving order details, and updating order status, with role-based access control and real-time broadcast of status updates.

classes.name: OrderCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating an order, including restaurant ID and delivery address.

classes.name: OrderResponse
classes.description: Schema for representing order data returned by API endpoints.

classes.name: OrderStatusUpdateRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating the status of an order.

classes.name: OrderEvent
classes.description: Model for tracking status changes of an order.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Order item details, including menu snapshot.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model with roles and identifiers.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Restaurant menu item with availability and pricing.

methods.name: OrderResponse _order_to_response(order: Order)
methods.description: Converts an Order database object into an OrderResponse schema for API response.

methods.name: OrderResponse create_order( payload: OrderCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
methods.description: Handles order placement by a customer, including cart processing, subtotal calculation, and broadcast.

methods.name: list[OrderResponse] list_my_orders( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders filtered by user role—customer, restaurant, or delivery person.

methods.name: OrderResponse get_order( order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific order with role-based access control.

methods.name: OrderResponse update_order_status( order_id: int, payload: OrderStatusUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Allows role-appropriate updating of order status and records order events.
